name: SGLang
summary: Apache-2.0 inference framework for LLM, vision-language and diffusion models, optimized for agentic workloads and large-scale serving.
description: Established open project (repo sgl-project/sglang; not archived; not presented as a 2026 launch). Root LICENSE is Apache-2.0; the PyPI license appendix names Copyright 2023-2024 SGLang Team. https://sglang.io 308s to https://www.sglang.io/ (HTTP 200); https://docs.sglang.ai 301s to https://docs.sglang.io/. This entry uses the final URLs. Docs https://docs.sglang.io/ and quickstart https://docs.sglang.io/docs/get-started/quickstart were HTTP 200 on 2026-11-14. https://cookbook.sglang.io/ 302s to https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/ and is not used as a URL or source. PyPI sglang 0.5.23 (not yanked; wheels uploaded 2026-10-30T01:34:33Z = 2026-10-30 02:34:33 Europe/Stockholm and following). GitHub latest release v0.5.23 was published 2026-11-02T22:14:10Z = 2026-11-02 23:14:10 Europe/Stockholm (not draft/prerelease). README documented install in an activated environment: uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang. That --prerelease=allow flag is as written in the README even though 0.5.23 is a non-yanked PyPI release; the command was not executed. README also describes a Docker path from lmsysorg/sglang:dev and contact sglang@lmsys.org for enterprise adoption. Model weights and any GPU or host resources are licensed and billed separately.
